description: Welcome to an exceptional residence defined by light, scale, and refined design. This 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home offers an expansive layout, highlighted by an extended upstairs primary suite featuring a generous walk-in closet and a spa-inspired soaking tub. A versatile loft or study and two additional en-suite bedrooms complete the upper level.  On the main floor, a private guest suite with a full bath is complemented by a flexible adjacent space ideal for a home office, au pair, or in-law accommodations. The chef's kitchen is thoughtfully appointed for elevated entertaining, seamlessly connecting to a formal dining room, butler's pantry, and inviting family room.  Step outside to a tranquil, resort-inspired garden where mature wisteria cascades over an elegant arbor, surrounded by curated succulents and seasonal blooms. This serene outdoor setting is perfect for both quiet mornings and sophisticated evening gatherings.  Additional features include a two-car garage with an extra refrigerator and generous storage. Ideally located with convenient access to Highway 101, premier shopping, and local amenities, this home offers an effortless blend of luxury and everyday convenience.
